decision.smallest_remaining_scientific_blocker: No governed ARCANA two-layer thermal reference-column contract exists for OrbData: at minimum crustal conductivity and radiogenic production, mantle radiogenic production, the asthenosphere adiabat/melting limits, and the definition that maps HWR-2's equilibrium plate thickness to ShellSet's age-dependent lithosphere thickness are unselected. Those quantities determine the active temperature profile and whether Assign changes heatFl or thickness. A0.6D's HWR reference values do not determine them.
decision.why_not_ready: The same heatFlow, crustal thickness and selected shared mantle values produce different Moho/base temperatures and different isostatic density columns as the unresolved OrbData-only material vector varies. Therefore profile consistency, limit activity and preservation cannot be proven from existing authority without selecting unsupported values.

source_basis.source: qualified ShellSet source extraction; OrbData5.f90 constants/driver; MOD_Data.f90 Assign/Squeez; MOD_ShellSet.f90 input bindings
unqualified local proposed patch; inspected statically only

sequence: OrbData5 driver reads a FEG nodal dQdTdA and elevation; zero heat-flow is treated as missing and triggers qArray loading. It applies qLimit=qLim0+dQL_dE*elevation, raises nonzero q to qLimit, then unconditionally caps at qLim1 before Assign.

Assign interpolates seafloor age and crust thickness. In the local proposed patch, arcanaMode AND arcanaOcean currently satisfies the ocean age-law condition, so the branch replaces explicit ARCANA heatFl with qLim1 at age<=0 or GDH1 for positive age.

Assign clamps crust thickness to cLimit..hCMax. The current ARCANA ocean branch still calculates lithosphere thickness from GDH1-derived q, TAsthK, TSurf, conduc(2), hardcoded q_radioactivity=0.007 W m-2 and h_plate=95000 m, then subtracts crust thickness and clamps to hLMax.

Assign builds a piecewise steady quadratic geotherm: crust geoth1..4; mantle geoth5..8. qRed removes crustal radiogenic production. If the computed Moho temperature exceeds TAsthK, Assign changes heatFl and clamps it again.
Assign calculates cooling_curvature to connect the mantle geotherm to TAsthK. If the chosen curvature implies an internal temperature maximum, it reduces mantle thickness and recomputes curvature.

Squeez caps profile temperatures at temLim only for its density/isostasy integration, integrates crust/mantle/water density contrasts against a reference column using alphaT, rhoBar, rhoAst, rhoH2O and gMean, and returns stress anomaly. Assign derives chemical_delta_rho from that anomaly, clips it to delta_rho_limit, and flags pressure or adiabat mismatch.

ShellSet's downstream mechanics consume dQdTdA, alphaT, conduc, tSurf, density anomaly, temLim and zBAsth in constitutive/thermal-mechanical routines. This is separate from the OrbData Assign geotherm reconstruction.

profile_equations.crust_temperature: T_C(z)=TSurf + (heatFl/conduc_C)z - radio_C*z^2/(2*conduc_C) - cooling_curvature*z^2/2 (base cubic term is zero)
profile_equations.reduced_mantle_flux: qRed=heatFl-thickC*radio_C (base); local final profile also subtracts cooling_curvature*thickC*conduc_M
profile_equations.mantle_temperature: T_M(z)=TMoho + qRed/conduc_M*z - radio_M*z^2/(2*conduc_M) - cooling_curvature*z^2/2 (base cubic term is zero)
profile_equations.adiabat_target: TAsthK=TADIAB+GRADIE*100000 m; in Assign this is the Moho/plate-base comparison and connection target, not an independently observed temperature
profile_equations.temperature_and_stress_checks: Squeez uses min(temLim_C/M,T_C/M) during density integration; Assign records badT when the final mantle-base/adiabat mismatch exceeds 20 K and badP when |sigZZB| exceeds 40 MPa.

active_thermal_control_flow.runtime_activation: The qualified source has these branches active when OrbData5 is called. The local ARCANA patch has not been qualified; its ARCANA branch currently enters the GDH1 ocean path.

parameters.name: alphaT_C
parameters.declaration_binding: MOD_Data Assign/Squeez array alphaT(1); ShellSet input name alphaT_C maps to alphaT(1).
parameters.active_equation: rho_C(T)=rhoBar_C*(1-alphaT_C*T)+density_anomaly in Squeez; used in ShellSet thermal-density/mechanical terms.
parameters.status: UNRESOLVED; no ARCANA crust material authority

parameters.name: alphaT_M
parameters.declaration_binding: input alphaT_M maps to alphaT(2).
parameters.active_equation: rho_M(T)=rhoBar_M*(1-alphaT_M*T)+density_anomaly; Squeez and ShellSet terms.

parameters.name: conduc_C
parameters.declaration_binding: input conduc_C maps to conduc(1).
parameters.active_equation: heatFl/conduc_C sets surface crust gradient; -radio_C/(2*conduc_C) sets profile curvature; TMoho check may alter heatFl.
parameters.status: UNRESOLVED; no ARCANA crust composition/conductivity authority

parameters.name: conduc_M
parameters.declaration_binding: input conduc_M maps to conduc(2).
parameters.active_equation: qRed/conduc_M sets mantle gradient; radio_M and curvature terms shape profile; enters stock GDH1 thickness equation.
parameters.authority: A0.6D HWR effective mantle conductivity selection; same value must bind producer and this OrbData mantle consumer

parameters.name: radio_C
parameters.declaration_binding: input radio_C maps to radio(1).
parameters.active_equation: reduces crust geotherm curvature and heat entering mantle: qRed=heatFl-thickC*radio_C.
parameters.status: UNRESOLVED; continental compositional/radiogenic inventory absent; ocean crust value cannot be inferred from heat flow alone

parameters.name: radio_M
parameters.declaration_binding: input radio_M maps to radio(2).
parameters.active_equation: mantle quadratic temperature profile and cooling-curvature calculation.
parameters.status: UNRESOLVED; no ARCANA mantle heat-production authority

parameters.name: rhoBar_C
parameters.declaration_binding: input rhoBar_C maps to rhoBar(1).
parameters.active_equation: reference crust density in thermal-density and stress/isostasy integration.
parameters.status: UNRESOLVED; physical crust-domain thickness does not determine composition/density

parameters.name: rhoBar_M
parameters.declaration_binding: input rhoBar_M maps to rhoBar(2).
parameters.active_equation: reference mantle density for Squeez density and HWR diffusivity authority.

parameters.name: rhoAst
parameters.declaration_binding: input rhoAst passed to Squeez and ShellSet; reference density below modeled plate in Squeez PRef column.
parameters.active_equation: sets reference-column density below 8 km interpolation to nDRef=300 km; affects isostatic stress anomaly and chemical_delta_rho.
parameters.status: UNRESOLVED; distinct from lithospheric rhoBar_M and needs a depth/composition profile

parameters.name: rhoH2O
parameters.declaration_binding: input rhoH2O passed to Squeez and ShellSet.
parameters.active_equation: water/sea column density in elevation-dependent reference stress column and ocean top loading.
parameters.authority: A0.6D liquid-water reference selection; runtime salinity/composition caveat retained

parameters.name: gMean
parameters.declaration_binding: canonical ShellSet parameter gMean bound into Assign and Squeez.
parameters.active_equation: multiplies reference lithostatic pressure increments and density/stress anomaly calculations in Squeez.
parameters.authority: Existing canonical R6 planetary gravity; source convention still requires qualification

parameters.name: tSurf / TSurf
parameters.declaration_binding: input tSurf passed to OrbData Assign as TSurf.
parameters.active_equation: surface boundary term in both crust and mantle geotherms.
parameters.scope: global/domain if surface climate field not supplied

parameters.name: temLim_C
parameters.declaration_binding: input temLim_C maps to temLim(1), called by Squeez tempC(h)=MIN(temLim_C, polynomial geotherm).
parameters.active_equation: caps temperature used in isostatic density/stress integration; it does not directly cap the emitted polynomial geotherm or input heatFl.
parameters.status: UNRESOLVED; depends on crust composition and pressure/water conditions

parameters.name: temLim_M
parameters.declaration_binding: input temLim_M maps to temLim(2).
parameters.active_equation: caps tempM(h) during Squeez density/stress integration.
parameters.status: UNRESOLVED; solidus depends on mantle composition, pressure and water

parameters.name: TADIAB
parameters.declaration_binding: ShellSet list input tAdiab; OrbData5 derives TAsthK=tAdiab+gradie*100000.
parameters.active_equation: sets one endpoint of the 100 km mantle adiabat reference.
parameters.status: A0.6D Tb is not sufficient to set tAdiab without an authorized adiabat and depth convention

parameters.name: GRADIE
parameters.declaration_binding: ShellSet list input gradie; multiplied by 100000 m in OrbData5 and consumed downstream in ShellSet.
parameters.active_equation: TAsthK=tAdiab+gradie*100000; sets reference gradient for upper mantle/asthenosphere profile.
parameters.status: Can be thermodynamically estimated from alpha*g*T/Cp, but source uses a linear constant gradient and needs an authorized reference temperature/depth pairing

parameters.name: TAsthK
parameters.declaration_binding: derived in OrbData5.f90 before node loop.
parameters.active_equation: TADIAB+GRADIE*100 km; Moho cap and plate-base adiabat target; mismatch threshold 20 K.
parameters.value: UNRESOLVED until TADIAB and GRADIE are bound

parameters.name: ZBASTH
parameters.declaration_binding: input list parameter zBAsth consumed in ShellSet profile/mechanical routines; input documentation describes depth of base of upper mantle/end of olivine-rich layer.
parameters.active_equation: downstream constitutive/thermal-mechanical depth control; not read by OrbData Assign geotherm equations.
parameters.status: The 400 km source example is Earth-specific and not an ARCANA selection

parameters.name: qLim0, dQL_dE, qLim1
parameters.declaration_binding: OrbData5 PARAMETER declarations and driver/Assign clamp sites.
parameters.units: W m-2; W m-2 m-1; W m-2
parameters.active_equation: qLimit=qLim0+dQL_dE*elevation; q=max(q,qLimit), then min(q,qLim1), repeated after geotherm correction.
parameters.value: qLim0=0; dQL_dE=0; qLim1=0.3 in extracted stock source
parameters.status: qLim1 incompatible with governed ARCANA; explicit mode must bypass all mutating clamp operations. Lower bound 0 is a nonbinding guard for positive q if used only as validation.

parameters.name: cLimit, hCMax, hLMax, delta_rho_limit
parameters.declaration_binding: OrbData5 PARAMETER declarations passed into Assign/Squeez.
parameters.active_equation: crust lower/upper clamp; total lithosphere upper clamp; chemical density anomaly cap.
parameters.value: 6570 m; 75000 m; 400000 m; 100 kg m-3 in extracted source
parameters.status: Stock values; ARCANA compatibility with governed min crust (6.5 km), total lithosphere maxima and material envelope must be verified, not assumed.

parameters.name: oneKm and nDRef
parameters.declaration_binding: ShellSet parameter oneKm and Squeez PARAMETER nDRef=300.
parameters.active_equation: oneKm sets vertical integration spacing and pressure accumulation; nDRef fixes Squeez reference-density/pressure profile depth and bounds allowed zStop.
parameters.value: oneKm is the configured kilometer in SI; nDRef=300 in source
parameters.status: Global source/numerical control; confirm actual SI binding and max supported lithosphere/elevation depth before qualification.

parameters.name: heat-production helper / h_plate
parameters.declaration_binding: local constants in ocean thickness branch of MOD_Data Assign.
parameters.active_equation: GDH1 thickness estimate h_Earth3=(TAsthK-TSurf)*conduc_M/(q_gdh1-q_radioactivity); geometric mean h_Earth5=sqrt(h_Earth3*h_plate).
parameters.status: Must not execute in explicit ARCANA ocean mode; Earth/stock calibration not transferable.

earth_input_example_excluded.treatment: Source example only; do not treat as ARCANA authority.

hybrid_profile_consistency.temperature_profile_difference: HWR-2 flux is generated from a transient constant-property finite plate. OrbData reconstructs a steady, piecewise quadratic crust/mantle geotherm with radiogenic terms and an adjusted cooling-curvature term, then checks/corrects it against an asthenosphere adiabat. It does not import the HWR temperature profile. A hybrid is possible, but consistency conditions must be governed and tested.
hybrid_profile_consistency.implied_gradient_formulas: At the surface, dT/dz=heatFl/conduc_C. At the Moho, mantle gradient begins from (heatFl-thickC*radio_C)/conduc_M, with cooling-curvature terms downstream.
hybrid_profile_consistency.numerical_gradient_test: Cannot compute a governed near-surface gradient because conduc_C is unselected. Do not substitute the HWR mantle effective k=3.3 for crust conductivity; crust and mantle are distinct material layers.
hybrid_profile_consistency.basal_consistency: For selected zp=100 km, HWR Tb=1680 K is a boundary condition at plate base. OrbData TAsthK is an unrelated parameter combination until TADIAB and GRADIE are governed. Assign will lower heatFl if Moho T exceeds TAsthK and may reduce mantle thickness if its quadratic profile has an internal maximum.
hybrid_profile_consistency.temperature_limits: temLim affects Squeez density integration and is composition/pressure/water dependent; the Earth input example 1223/1673 K is not authorized. Cannot prove its active/inactive status on ARCANA profiles without the reference-column/material contract.
hybrid_profile_consistency.material_transition: Assign constructs continuous temperature at Moho algebraically, but crust and mantle gradients can differ according to their separate conductivity and heat-production terms. No explicit cross-cell or continent/ocean interface temperature/flux continuity rule is selected in the ARCANA domain contract.
hybrid_profile_consistency.moho_conductive_flux_audit: Static differentiation of the extracted final polynomial gives q_C(Moho-)=heatFl-thickC*radio_C-cooling_curvature*thickC*conduc_C, while Assign sets mantle qRed=heatFl-thickC*radio_C-cooling_curvature*thickC*conduc_M. These are unequal when cooling_curvature is nonzero and conduc_C differs from conduc_M. No Moho heat source/sink authority is present to explain the jump. The ARCANA source path must enforce flux continuity or explicitly govern the interface term; do not assume the stock expression is self-consistent.
hybrid_profile_consistency.ridge: q=0.3 W m-2 is finite and HWR-2 is not evaluated at t=0. OrbData's current stock zero-age path assigns qLim1 (numerically coincident at 0.3) and uses GDH1 thickness; that coincidence does not provide an ARCANA ridge profile authority. Ridge profile must use explicit q and a governed thickness/reference-column treatment.
hybrid_profile_consistency.quantitative_check: A0.6D nominal HWR q spans 0.0476525..0.4741483 W m-2; with the selected mantle effective conductivity, these correspond to q/conduc_M of 14.44..143.68 K km-1 as a mantle-gradient scale only. This is not the crust surface gradient, and cannot be integrated through the crust until conduc_C and radio_C are selected.
hybrid_profile_consistency.domain_join: No material-transition smoothing or interface condition may be inferred from the global raster projection. A domain-aware producer/projector must retain explicit domain membership and require a declared interface policy.

continental_profile_contract.inputs: Ratified authored q=0.045/0.060/0.085 W m-2 for cold stable/normal/hot extended domains; T0 crust thickness values vary by physical crust domain; total lithosphere references are 200/135/80 km for the three thermal classes.
continental_profile_contract.proposed_arcana_thickness_path: Local patch's ELSE IF arcanaMode path requests ARCANA total lithosphere then computes mantle thickness=total-crust and clamps. Later internal-max correction may still change mantle thickness.
continental_profile_contract.consistency: Cannot calculate crust/Moho/base temperatures or test temLim/TAsthK without conduc_C, radio_C/M and adiabat authority. In production, preserve authorized total thickness or reject an infeasible profile; no silent source adjustment.

ocean_profile_contract.inputs: All 50,434 positive-age ocean cells use selected HWR-2 flux for t>0; age range 1.1491667..160 Ma; selected HWR reference zp=100 km; separate 108-cell ridge support.
ocean_profile_contract.current_patch_behavior: ARCANA ocean condition enters the age override and the GDH1/95-km thickness branch; explicit heatFl and plate thickness are not preserved.
ocean_profile_contract.required_profile: Pass governed HWR heatFl and the one authorized ocean thickness profile/definition. Validate the OrbData steady piecewise geotherm against TSurf/TBasal/temLim and fail closed if constraints require modifying explicit producer flux or thickness.
ocean_profile_contract.blocker: The relationship between HWR-2 equilibrium thickness zp and age-dependent OrbData/ShellSet tLNode is not selected; 100 km cannot simply be broadcast over all ages as an unexamined identity.

ridge_profile_contract.hwr2_t_zero: Not evaluated; singular HWR-2 limit excluded.
ridge_profile_contract.required_behavior: Use explicit q_ridge and a governed finite profile/thickness condition. Do not infer ridge profile from stock qLim1 coincidence or GDH1.

qlim_preservation_contract.explicit_arcana: Bypass mutating qLim1 and any heat-flow replacement. qLim0/dQL_dE may be retained only as a nonmutating assertion (currently exactly 0 over T0); if assertion fails, reject input. A later geotherm consistency correction may not edit heatFl; fail closed instead.
qlim_preservation_contract.legacy: When explicit ARCANA authority is absent, preserve stock qLim/GDH1 behavior unchanged.
qlim_preservation_contract.explicit_operation_exception: Only an ARCANA separately governed physical operation may modify heatFl; no such correction currently exists.

gdh1_preservation_contract.explicit_arcana_ocean: GDH1 heat-flow assignment must not run; retain validated producer heatFl, including ridge's explicit 0.3 W m-2.
gdh1_preservation_contract.legacy_non_arcana: Keep age<200 GDH1 behavior, qLim1 zero-age stock substitution and legacy fallbacks unchanged.
gdh1_preservation_contract.incomplete_input: Reject partial ARCANA input pair and invalid/zero sentinel support before Assign; missingness and domain are separate masks.

lithosphere_thickness_contract.stock_ocean: Age-dependent GDH1 q, stock q clamps, h_Earth3 and fixed 95 km h_plate geometric mean determine total thickness; crust is subtracted to get thickM; hLMax clamps total.
lithosphere_thickness_contract.stock_continent: S-wave travel-time anomaly is converted to thickM with slope 1.494/85000 seconds per meter and ridge delta_tS 1.636 s; no ARCANA authored reference thickness is used unless local patch path activates.
lithosphere_thickness_contract.arcana_continent: Requested total reference is passed, but post-geotherm shape safeguards can reduce thickM; preservation/fail-closed behavior required.
lithosphere_thickness_contract.arcana_ocean: Current proposed patch still enters stock GDH1 thickness formula. Must bypass and consume explicit producer thermal thickness or a shared derived field.
lithosphere_thickness_contract.scientific_identity: HWR-2 equilibrium z_p is fixed plate-model asymptotic thickness. OrbData tLNode is a per-node lithosphere thickness used in isostatic/mechanical state. Their mapping requires an explicit threshold/definition or an authorial rule; do not set them equal without that authority.

required_quantities_still_unselected: HWR zp to age-dependent tLNode mapping
config_v1_readiness.reason: Config V1 must contain all active thermal inputs and profile/thickness policies. The prior A0.6D values bind only shared HWR/mantle references and cannot determine these material-/OrbData-specific quantities.

required_source_changes.A_arcana_heat_flow_producer: Materialize complete nonzero domain-supported continental/ridge/HWR-2 heatFl plus explicit validity/domain masks; deterministic inputs include parent field hashes, parameter values/ranges, numerical convergence and boundary masks.
required_source_changes.B_feg_domain_projection: Project heat flow, age/domain identity and thickness with a declared spherical interpolation/conservative policy that does not blend across crust-domain classes; validate complete FEG support and error bounds; UNKNOWN stays a mask, never zero.
required_source_changes.C_shellset_heat_flow: In src/OrbData5.f90 driver clamp and src/MOD_Data.f90::Assign, branch on validated explicit ARCANA heat-flow authority: preserve supplied heatFl, bypass GDH1 and mutating qLim1/qLim0 clamps, and fail closed if thermal/geotherm consistency would alter it. Preserve all stock behavior when ARCANA authority is absent. In the ARCANA geotherm path, derive the Moho reduced flux using the crust-side cooling-curvature conductivity (or an algebraically equivalent flux-continuous interface condition), then use that same interface flux in the mantle profile.
required_source_changes.D_shellset_thickness: In src/MOD_Data.f90::Assign ocean-age thickness branch, bypass GDH1 q/h_Earth3/95-km h_plate calculation for ARCANA; consume the governed projected ARCANA tL field. In the continental ARCANA branch, prevent curvature/internal-maximum safeguards from silently changing authored thickness; fail closed if incompatible. src/OrbData5.f90 must pass complete masks/values and reject partial input.

remaining_scientific_blockers.statement: Select and ratify one two-layer ARCANA crust/mantle reference-column contract that supplies remaining material-dependent geotherm and temperature-limit values and explicitly maps HWR-2 equilibrium thickness to per-node ShellSet lithosphere thickness. Required before profile consistency and Config V1 can close.
remaining_scientific_blockers.minimum_fields: conduc_C, radio_C/M, rhoBar_C, rhoAst reference/depth law, temLim_C/M or governed solidus law, TADIAB/GRADIE semantics and parameter pair, ZBASTH if active in selected mechanics, and HWR-zp-to-tL definition.
remaining_scientific_blockers.why_this_is_one_blocker: These are coupled members of the same missing ARCANA reference-column/material authority; assigning isolated values would create the duplicated or internally inconsistent controls this task forbids.

remaining_implementation_blockers: Heat-flow and thickness preservation source changes above are not implemented or qualified.
No FEG domain-aware projection/replay has been authorized or qualified.
Pinned-source qualification of the local proposed adapter patch remains incomplete.

targeted_literature.use: Supports derivability of an adiabatic gradient from material properties, but not the unselected reference depth/potential temperature convention.

targeted_literature.citation: Till et al. (2010), low-extent melts at the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary
targeted_literature.use: Shows peridotite solidus varies with composition and water, so Earth example temLim is not transferable without ARCANA material/composition authority.

targeted_literature.use: Shows crustal radiogenic production depends on crustal composition/domain; no selected ARCANA composition exists.
